About.Name: Flow Field Pathfinding
About.Author: Flow Field Pathfinding
About.Comment: Top-down pathfinding for many objects at once. Add your walls, then ask which direction an object should move to reach another object. Everything heading for the same spot shares one calculation, so it stays fast with many instances.

Properties.Title: Cell size (pixels)
Properties.Info: Size of one grid cell in pixels. Smaller cells follow walls more precisely but cost more to calculate. 16 works well for most games; try 8 for tight spaces.

Properties.Title: Grid width (cells, 0 = fit frame)
Properties.Info: Number of cells across the grid. Leave at 0 to cover the whole frame width.

Properties.Title: Grid height (cells, 0 = fit frame)
Properties.Info: Number of cells down the grid. Leave at 0 to cover the whole frame height.

Properties.Title: Import Fusion obstacles on start
Properties.Info: Tick to copy Fusion's own obstacle objects (backdrops set to Obstacle) into the grid when the frame starts. The Add Fusion obstacles action does the same at any time.

Properties.Title: Cells processed per frame (0 = unlimited)
Properties.Info: Limits how many cells are processed each frame when targets move, spreading the work over several frames. 0 = no limit, so answers are always up to date. Try 20000 if the game stutters.
